title: Update release team membership
author: nabetetsu

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
In order to update team members, I usually ask for some evidence that the new members are indeed maintainers of the packages which this team has access to. 

Most commonly, this is a link to a `<maintainer>` or `<author>` field in a package's package.xml file. For example: https://github.com/ros2/ros_workspace/blob/latest/package.xml#L14

Since this team corresponds to an organization on GitHub, public evidence of membership in the GitHub organization or a +1 from this team's current members: @wep21 would also be acceptable.

comments.author: wep21
comments.body: @nuclearsandwich It's no problem to add @nabetetsu only.
